content: RTE fan-out support The RTE fan-out (signal fan-out) is de- scribed by the relation between SystemSignal and ISignal . In the case of a "signal fan-out", several ISignal s refer to the same SystemSignal as shown in the following example.

RTE fan-out support for a SystemSignal The RTE fan-out (signal fan-out) from a SystemSignal to multiple ISignal s is enabled in the System Description if the following conditions apply: • several ISignal s reference the SystemSignal in the role systemSignal and • the SystemSignal is not referenced by a SystemSignalGroup • a DataMapping references the SystemSignal and • the DataMapping references an element in a PPortPrototype and • the ISignal s are transmitted by the EcuInstance on which the RTE is run- ning, i.e. an ISignalTriggering exists that references the ISignal in the role iSignal and references a ISignalPort of the EcuInstance with com- municationDirection out .
